subject: general
question: Which of the following phenomena is NOT involved during the formation of a rainbow?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Scattering.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **method of a rainbow's production doesn't include scattering.**
 
• The **phenomena of dispersion, refraction and internal reflection are involved in the production of a rainbow.**
 
• A rainbow is a naturally occurring **spectrum** that develops **after a downpour of rain **(**each drop of water functions as a tiny prism**) as a result of the dispersion, refraction, and internal reflection of many colours.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dispersion**

 
 
• ​The **breaking of the light beam into its seven individual colours** when it passes through **any transparent medium is known as dispersion of light.**
 
• **Sir Isaac Newton** described this phenomenon in the year 1666. He found that when sunlight travels through a** glass prism**, white light is composed of **seven distinct colours kinds.**
 
 
 
• **Scattering**
 
 
• ​The **process of electromagnetic energy** being reflected off of the atoms or molecules of the medium they are travelling through is known as a scattering of light. **Light scattering occurs when light is absorbed by the medium's molecules, which then reradiates the light in various directions.**​
 
 
 
• **Refraction**
 
 
• ​The **phenomenon of light bending and moving from one transparent substance to another is known as the refraction of light.**
 
 
 
• **Total internal reflection**
 
 
• ​**Total**** refraction of a light ray from the surrounding surfaces back into a medium like glass or water. **If the incidence angle exceeds a specific limitation angle known as the** critical angle,** the phenomenon will manifest.
